literal: Exalted principles-those if enraged, in the middle having broken, even a king kingship will perish.
translation: If those of exalted principles become enraged, even a king will break mid-way and lose his kingdom.
modern: உயர்ந்த கொள்கைகளை உடைய பெரியவர்கள் சினந்தால், ஒரு அரசனும் தன் இடையில் முறிந்து தன் அரச பதவியை இழந்து அழிவான்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the devastating consequences of angering people of high principles. The phrase 'ஏந்திய கொள்கையார்' refers to those who hold elevated, unwavering ideals. 'சீறின்' means if they hiss or become enraged, comparing their righteous anger to a snake's strike. The consequence is described vividly as 'இடை முரிந்து' (breaking in the middle), meaning the offender's life or reign will be snapped abruptly before its natural end. Even a powerful king ('வேந்தனும்') will lose his very kingship ('வேந்து கெடும்') if he incurs their wrath.
